from solution import sum_Pairs


def test_issue_example():
    """Example sum_Pairs([1,8,9,15,16],5) == 74."""
    # 7+8+14+15+1+7+8+6+7+1 = 74
    assert sum_Pairs([1, 8, 9, 15, 16], 5) == 74


def test_issue_two_elements():
    """Sum of absolute differences in all pairs with two elements."""
    # |4-9| = 5
    assert sum_Pairs([4, 9], 2) == 5


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Sum of absolute differences in all pairs with one element has no pairs."""
    # no pairs so sum = 0
    assert sum_Pairs([42], 1) == 0


def test_issue_empty_array():
    """Sum of absolute differences in all pairs of empty array is zero."""
    # no pairs so sum = 0
    assert sum_Pairs([], 0) == 0


def test_issue_three_consecutive():
    """Sum of absolute differences in all pairs of [1,2,3]."""
    # 1+2+1 = 4
    assert sum_Pairs([1, 2, 3], 3) == 4


def test_issue_all_equal():
    """Sum of absolute differences in all pairs is zero when all equal."""
    # 0+0+0+0+0+0 = 0
    assert sum_Pairs([7, 7, 7, 7], 4) == 0


def test_issue_negative_values():
    """Sum of absolute differences in all pairs handles negatives."""
    # 5+10+5 = 20
    assert sum_Pairs([-5, 0, 5], 3) == 20


def test_issue_unsorted_order():
    """Sum of absolute differences in all pairs is order independent."""
    # 7+8+14+15+1+7+8+6+7+1 = 74
    assert sum_Pairs([9, 1, 16, 8, 15], 5) == 74


def test_issue_evenly_spaced():
    """Sum of absolute differences in all pairs of [0,10,20,30]."""
    # 10+20+30+10+20+10 = 100
    assert sum_Pairs([0, 10, 20, 30], 4) == 100


def test_contract_absolute_difference():
    """Contract: sum uses absolute differences in all pairs."""
    # |10-1| = 9
    assert sum_Pairs([10, 1], 2) == 9


def test_contract_all_pairs():
    """Contract: sum covers all pairs of the given array, not just adjacent."""
    # 1+3+7+2+6+4 = 23
    assert sum_Pairs([1, 2, 4, 8], 4) == 23
